title: skills/docs: teach lookupAutofill (lookup-pick fills declared fields) once the ui half fills the form
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ② This card carries the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #28244 (#27945). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and routes it. `skills/**` is governed and belongs to the skills lane.

Reach: AI authors and app builders who model a lookup that should copy values on pick. After #28244, `FieldSchema.lookupAutofill: [{ target, source, overwrite? }]` is declared, but nothing teaches it. Teaching it before the ui half (#28245) lands would advertise a fill that nothing performs, so this card lands with #28245 or right after it.

## Files

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`: the lookup / master_detail section.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`: the hand-written page.

## What changes

- Teach the declaration and its rules:
  - a single-value lookup only;
  - the target is a field of this object that is not readonly or computed;
  - the source is a declared, non-internal field of the lookup's object, with a compatible type;
  - the overwrite rule (fill an empty target, or one an earlier pick filled; `overwrite: true` replaces);
  - how it relates to the line-item grid's `autofill` key.
- Run the skill's evals.

Links: #27945, PR #28244, #28245 (ui half).

Blocked-by: #28245
